title: PhishGuard Pro
alt: PhishGuard Pro URL Analysis showing a 100 out of 100 critical risk score for a phishing link
summary: A phishing URL triage tool. Paste a link and get a 0 to 100 risk score, the redirect chain, reputation from five sources and a sandbox screenshot, plus defanged IOCs and starter Sigma, Splunk and Sentinel queries.

title: Wi-Fi Remote PC Power Control
summary: An ESP8266-based Wi-Fi board that lets me power a PC on, off and reset it remotely. I installed it in my home lab PC and wrote the setup guide: front-panel wiring, pass-through to the motherboard and Wi-Fi configuration.
alt: The ESP8266 Wi-Fi remote power controller board, with INPUT and OUTPUT front-panel headers
